description: This Java abstract class provides a base implementation for HTTP services using Vert.x, including server setup, routing, endpoint management, and health checks.

classes.name: HttpServiceBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for HTTP services, managing server lifecycle, routing, endpoints, and health checks using Vert.x.

methods.name: addEndpoints
methods.description: Adds multiple HttpEndpoint instances to the service.

methods.name: addEndpoint
methods.description: Adds a single HttpEndpoint to the service.

methods.name: setAuthHandler
methods.description: Sets the authentication handler for the service.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the service configuration, with qualifier for REST.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns default secure port (8443).

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns default insecure port (8080).

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Returns the actual port the secure server is listening on.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the actual port the insecure server is listening on.

methods.name: preStartServers
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform initialization before server start.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Starts the HTTP servers and endpoints, including secure and insecure servers.

methods.name: onStartupSuccess
methods.description: Hook for subclasses after successful startup.

methods.name: createRouter
methods.description: Creates and configures the Vert.x Router with tracing, failure, body size, and auth handlers.

methods.name: createTracingHandler
methods.description: Creates a tracing handler with custom tags for request tracing.

methods.name: addAuthHandler
methods.description: Adds authentication handler to the router if configured.

methods.name: addCustomTags
methods.description: Allows subclasses to add custom tags for tracing.

methods.name: addEndpointRoutes
methods.description: Registers routes for all endpoints.

methods.name: addCustomRoutes
methods.description: Allows subclasses to add additional custom routes before server start.

methods.name: getHttpServerOptions
methods.description: Provides default HTTP server options with TLS configuration.

methods.name: getInsecureHttpServerOptions
methods.description: Provides default HTTP server options for insecure server.

methods.name: bindSecureHttpServer
methods.description: Binds and starts the secure HTTP server.

methods.name: bindInsecureHttpServer
methods.description: Binds and starts the insecure HTTP server.

methods.name: startEndpoints
methods.description: Starts all registered endpoints and adds their routes.

methods.name: stopEndpoints
methods.description: Stops all registered endpoints.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Stops servers and endpoints, performs cleanup after shutdown.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the secure HTTP server.

methods.name: stopInsecureServer
methods.description: Stops the insecure HTTP server.

methods.name: preShutdown
methods.description: Hook for subclasses before shutdown.

methods.name: postShutdown
methods.description: Hook for subclasses after shutdown.
